name: @rpgm-tools/neo-angband-mod-sdk
description: Pack schemas, validation, and tooling for Neo Angband mods (content packs, tile packs, scripted plugins)
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
//bin: The plugin builder ships with the SDK because the rules it enforces ARE the plugin
ABI, and every mod - first-party included - now lives in its own repository. It
drives esbuild, which is deliberately NOT a dependency: this package is imported at
runtime by the web build to validate manifests, and a native binary in that tree
would cost every consumer for a tool only mod authors run. The bin resolves it when
it runs and names the remedy when it is missing.
//publishConfig: provenance is deliberately absent - trusted publishing attaches it with no flag,
and the flag would break the one manual publish a new package needs. The long
version is in packages/core/package.json and docs/RELEASING.md step 4.
